temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is a dedicated and hardworking friend, but Ethan has begun to see Gary's recent work habits as concerning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital obligations are overwhelming enough to keep him from taking even a short restorative break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is seriously overcommitted at the hospital and may be neglecting his health; his professional obligations are currently a major obstacle to rest.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene by encouraging Gary to take a break and to help him prioritize his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overcommitted at the hospital and may be neglecting his health, and he initially resisted taking a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Gary's restlessness and avoidance, plus his 'complicated' response, suggest his overwork is not only professional and that he is hiding personal difficulties.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with deeper, possibly personal, complications behind his overwork, and he is reluctant to share them despite their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary, reassure him he can speak openly, and offer nonjudgmental help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. He accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and get help organizing his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is dealing with deeper personal and professional complications behind his overwork and is reluctant to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Ethan now understands the specific causes of Gary's overwork, and Gary is willing to accept practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by concrete professional pressures and personal challenges; with practical support, he can work toward a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find a better work-life balance by prioritizing tasks, delegating responsibilities, and organizing his schedule.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress and remaining challenges, saying he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary needs support to manage professional and personal pressures, but he can improve with practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Gary's reports and behavior show meaningful improvement; the support is helping, and Gary is actively trying to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making real progress toward better balance, though challenges may remain; continued encouragement is useful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep checking in, discuss progress and challenges, and continue offering support and encouragement.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and credits Ethan's support. Ethan decides it is time to step back while remaining available.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is making progress and still benefits from Ethan's ongoing check-ins and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Gary is now capable of managing his work-life balance independently, so active intervention is no longer needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and autonomy; Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support but remain available if Gary ever needs him.
